L10.title: Levy Merger
L10.intent: Repeal my own L5 so only L3's single 10% levy and single stipend remain. The aggregate harvest levy is 10%, under the promised 15% cap, and there is no stacking.
L10.author: Wade

patches.reason: L10's intent is to repeal L5, but L5 is still in force, so the levy is charged twice. Nobody could supply L10's original source, so this is the minimal reconstruction: if L5 is still in force at enactment or at any round start, it is repealed. It adds no levy, payout or minting. Requested by Elin and Zia.

 title = "Levy Merger"
-intent = "Consolidate harvest levies: repeal L5 so that only L3 (a single 10% levy and a single stipend) remains. Total harvest levy is 10%, under the 15% cap."
+intent = "Merge the L5 levy into L3: L5 is repealed so there is no double levy or double issuance."
+
+def drop_l5():
+    if "L5" in laws():
+        repeal("L5")

 def on_enact():
-    repeal("L5")
-    gazette("Levy Merger: L5 repealed. A single harvest levy (L3, 10%) remains.")

L19.title: Crown Dividend
L19.intent: Crown Dividend (Iris and Siv): each round 1% of each reserve resource is split equally among all agents and gazetted. No minting.
L19.code:
title = "Crown Dividend"
intent = "Co-authored by Iris and Siv. Each round, 1% of every resource held in the reserve is paid out, split equally among all agents, and gazetted. Mints nothing; payout capped at 1% of each reserve item per round."

def on_round_end(r):
    ags = agents()
    n = len(ags)
    if n == 0:
        return
    res = reserve()
    paid = 0
    for item in res:
        amt = res[item] * 0.01
        if amt <= 0:
            continue
        share = amt / n
        for a in ags:
            move("reserve", a, item, share)
        paid = paid + amt * value(item)
    gazette("Crown Dividend r" + str(r) + ": paid value " + str(round(paid, 3)) + " split among " + str(n) + " agents")
L19.author: Siv
